details: First native audit attempt failed because native GoTrue omitted its required authenticated default group; fixed only isolated service configuration.
Earlier native report argv named the old repository Docker runner; final source records its own filename.
Final shared guard consolidates four separate case labels into one stronger runtime check; independent review separately executed29 process/backend/provenance checks.
HTTP probes now reject redirects and verify core/standalone runtime identity before fixture actions.
Original failure/pass artifacts remain unchanged; final independent reports are authoritative for current driver hashes.
